name: discover-tridentum
description: Discover Tridentum — la guida che racconta la Trento che non trovi su Google

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c red,blue "npm run dev -w src/backend" "npm run dev -w src/frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start -w src/backend
scripts.test: npm test -w src/frontend && npm test -w src/backend
